_comment: English UI text exactly as it was before multi-language support (v2.12 /start, /help, /settings, /menu header), with placeholders NEKO/USER; tests/test_i18n.py proves the catalog-built English output still equals it (plus the lines added on purpose).
start: 👋 Welcome, USER! 🚀 NEKO — moderation, live voice-chat music, Unicode fonts, and more — all in one bot. /ai = general assistant · /chat (or @mention / reply) = Neko personality Tap a button below, or send /help for the full command list.
help: 📚 NEKO Help 👮 Moderation: /ban /mute /kick /warn /unban /unmute /tmute /tban /purge — also /dban /sban /dwarn variants 🛡️ Security: antiflood & antispam (automatic), /locks /nightmode /captcha /blacklist /approve /modsettings 📝 Management: /notes /filters /welcome /rules /setwelcome /setrules /connect 🤖 AI assistant: /ai /imagine /summarize /code /see /transcribe /persona 🎭 Neko personality: /chat — or @mention / reply to the bot (ambient banter on by default in DMs; /personality on|off in groups) 🎌 Anime: /anime /manga /manhwa /manhua /novel /movie /char /relations /watch /seasonal /topanime /topmanga /topcharacters /top /airing /upcoming /anischedule /browse /rec /fillers /user /flex /alauth /activity /favourites (AniList + MyAnimeList) 🎵 Media files: /music /yt /insta /tts /qr 🎧 Live VC music: /play /skip /pause /resume /stop /queue /nowplaying /volume /shuffle /repeat /effects /loop /seek /playlist /lyrics (needs MUSIC_API_ID/HASH + active voice chat) 🎯 Fun: /fun /couples /meme /cosplay /quote /wish /joke 🎴 Collector: /grab /collection /characters /fav /myprofile /topcatchers /trade /gift — see /chelp 💰 Economy: /daily /balance /pay /shop /buy /level /leaderboard 🔧 Utilities: /id /info /names /tr /ud /weather /qr /calc /imdb /tagall /dice 🔎 Reference: /pokedex /currency /convert /telegraph · 🏷 Stickers: /kang /packinfo /q 📊 Stats: /stats /mystats /botstats /top /leaderboard 🌐 Fed: /newfed /joinfed /leavefed /fedban /unfedban /fedinfo /fpromote 🛠 More admin: /disable /enable /disabled /zombies /rmzombies /unbanall /names 🛡 Ops (sudo): /globalstats /activevc /blacklistchat /authorize /maintenance /privatemode /cleanmode /autoend /gban /block 🎭 Personality extras: /personality on|off, /joke, /nnr_settings, /nnr_help 🔤 Fonts: /f1–/f18, /flip, /fontfx, /fonts 🤗 Reactions: /reactions on|off, /hug /pat /kiss /cuddle /slap … Tap /menu for the control panel, or /settings for quick toggles.
